# Strip report

<!-- Generated by scripts/strip-report.py; do not edit by hand. -->

Every place where the Photovault apps still mention Ente, an Ente host, or a stripped company service (billing, referrals, crash reporting, store links), and why it stays. Generated by `python3 -I scripts/strip-report.py` from the explanations in `scripts/strip-allowlist.toml`; CI runs it with `--check`, which fails on any unexplained hit.

Scanned: source: 2886 files.
Comments are not scanned. Terms marked *visible* only count in text a user can see (string literals, markup, translation values); the others count anywhere outside comments.

| Category | Meaning | Hits |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| about-credit | The plain "Based on Ente" credit in About, the one allowed user-visible mention of Ente. | 3 |
| internal-identifier | Identifiers that are never shown as text: URI schemes, package/app ids, enum values, storage keys, CSS hooks, file names. | 56 |
| api-field-name | Names in the Ente API that the Photovault server implements (paths, JSON fields, models); renaming them breaks the protocol. | 20 |
| server-plan-wording | Generic plan/subscription wording for errors the Photovault server really returns (it keeps museum's per-user plan: quota and expiry, set by the admin). Not Ente branding. | 5 |
| log-message | Developer log or diagnostic text (logs, adb dumps, exceptions caught and logged); not shown in the UI. | 26 |
| unused-string | Translation value whose key no Photovault app code references any more; never displayed. | 317 |
| upstream-only-app-not-built | Code path or text that runs only for Ente's other apps (Auth, Locker, Legacy Kit, Space) or platforms Photovault does not ship. | 23 |
| upstream-security-logic | Upstream security checks that name Ente hosts; left untouched so security is not weakened. | 7 |
| inert-config | Configuration that names an Ente host or service but makes no request and shows nothing. | 10 |
| replaced-asset-path | Asset file name kept from upstream; the content (duck mascot) was replaced or is no longer drawn. | 9 |
| pending-user-decision | Still contacts an Ente host; left on purpose until the project owner decides (ML model downloads). | 7 |
| third-party-data | Data inside a bundled third-party library (word lists etc.). | 0 |
| package-metadata | Package/build metadata (pubspec description, package.json name) that is not shipped in or shown by the apps. | 27 |

## Excluded paths

Not scanned at all (build output, tests, generated code):

| Path | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| `*/node_modules/*` | third-party packages |
| `*/build/*` | build output |
| `*/.dart_tool/*` | Flutter tool cache |
| `*/.gradle/*` | Gradle cache |
| `*/.cxx/*` | native build cache |
| `*/Pods/*` | CocoaPods checkout |
| `web/apps/*/.next/*` | Next.js build cache (the export is scanned with --web-out instead) |
| `web/apps/*/out/*` | web static export (scanned with --web-out) |
| `*/test/*` | tests, not shipped |
| `*/tests/*` | tests, not shipped |
| `*/Tests/*` | tests, not shipped |
| `*/integration_test/*` | tests, not shipped |
| `rust/*/tests.rs` | Rust test modules, not shipped |
| `rust/*/test_*.rs` | Rust test modules, not shipped |
| `*.test.ts` | tests, not shipped |
| `*.g.dart` | generated code (json_serializable etc.); its source is scanned |
| `*.freezed.dart` | generated code; its source is scanned |
| `mobile/packages/strings/lib/l10n/strings_localizations*.dart` | generated from the .arb files, which are scanned |
| `mobile/apps/photos/lib/generated/*` | generated from the .arb files, which are scanned |
| `mobile/apps/photos/scripts/*` | developer scripts (perf tests, asset renderers); not compiled into the app |
| `mobile/packages/ente_components/example/*` | component catalog example app; not built or shipped |
| `*/pubspec.lock` | dependency lockfile, not shipped |
| `*/package-lock.json` | dependency lockfile, not shipped |
| `web/packages/wasm/*/pkg/*` | generated wasm-bindgen output; its Rust source (rust/bindings/wasm/*) is scanned |
